candidates.label: Perfection of religion: divine declaration of completed revelation finalized favor and approved Islam as definitive way of life
candidates.definition: In 5:3: This day I have perfected for you your religion and completed My favor upon you and have approved for you Islam as religion. Declared alongside dietary legislation marking comprehensive legal-theological culmination.

evidence.excerpt: حُرِّمَتۡ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡمَيۡتَةُ وَٱلدَّمُ وَلَحۡمُ ٱلۡخِنزِيرِ وَمَآ أُهِلَّ لِغَيۡرِ ٱللَّهِ بِهِۦ وَٱلۡمُنۡخَنِقَةُ وَٱلۡمَوۡقُوذَةُ وَٱلۡمُتَرَدِّيَةُ وَٱلنَّطِيحَةُ وَمَآ أَكَلَ ٱلسَّبُعُ إِلَّا مَا ذَكَّيۡتُمۡ وَمَا ذُبِحَ عَلَى ٱلنُّصُبِ وَأَن تَسۡتَقۡسِمُواْ بِٱلۡأَزۡلَٰمِۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ فِسۡقٌۗ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ يَئِسَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن دِينِكُمۡ فَلَا تَخۡشَوۡهُمۡ وَٱخۡشَوۡنِۚ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ أَكۡمَلۡتُ لَكُمۡ دِينَكُمۡ وَأَتۡمَمۡتُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ نِعۡمَتِي وَرَضِيتُ لَكُمُ ٱلۡإِسۡلَٰمَ دِينٗاۚ فَمَنِ ٱضۡطُرَّ فِي مَخۡمَصَةٍ غَيۡرَ مُتَجَانِفٖ لِّإِثۡمٖ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
evidence.rationale: Alyawma akmaltu lakum deenakum waatmamtu AAalaykum niAAmatee waradeetu lakumu alislama deenan: three-fold declaration (perfection completion approval). Alyawma anchors in specific revelatory moment. Deen encompasses total way of life not merely creed. Radeetu implies divine satisfaction and final selection.

candidates.urduLabel: إكمال الدين: إعلان إلهي باكتمال الوحي وإتمام النعمة وارتضاء الإسلام ديناً
candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Most explicit Quranic statement of revelatory closure. Triple formula (ikmal itmam rida) suggests progressive stages reaching culmination. Context within dietary law suggests perfection includes practical legislation not only doctrine. Foundation for Islamic self-understanding as final dispensation.

candidates.label: Cooperative ethics: positive obligation to collaborate in righteousness and taqwa with corresponding prohibition against collaboration in sin and aggression
candidates.definition: In 5:2: Cooperate in righteousness and taqwa and do not cooperate in sin and aggression. And fear Allah; indeed Allah is severe in penalty.

evidence.excerpt: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تُحِلُّواْ شَعَـٰٓئِرَ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا ٱلشَّهۡرَ ٱلۡحَرَامَ وَلَا ٱلۡهَدۡيَ وَلَا ٱلۡقَلَـٰٓئِدَ وَلَآ ءَآمِّينَ ٱلۡبَيۡتَ ٱلۡحَرَامَ يَبۡتَغُونَ فَضۡلٗا مِّن رَّبِّهِمۡ وَرِضۡوَٰنٗاۚ وَإِذَا حَلَلۡتُمۡ فَٱصۡطَادُواْۚ وَلَا يَجۡرِمَنَّكُمۡ شَنَـَٔانُ قَوۡمٍ أَن صَدُّوكُمۡ عَنِ ٱلۡمَسۡجِدِ ٱلۡحَرَامِ أَن تَعۡتَدُواْۘ وَتَعَاوَنُواْ عَلَى ٱلۡبِرِّ وَٱلتَّقۡوَىٰۖ وَلَا تَعَاوَنُواْ عَلَى ٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَٱلۡعُدۡوَٰنِۚ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلۡعِقَابِ
evidence.rationale: WataAAawanoo AAala albirri waalttaqwa wala taAAawanoo AAala alithmi waalAAudwani: symmetric command-prohibition pairing. Birr and taqwa define positive scope; ithm and udwan define negative scope. TaAAawanoo (cooperate) implies active collective effort not passive coexistence. Shadeedu al-iqab reinforces seriousness.

candidates.urduLabel: أخلاق التعاون: وجوب التعاون على البر والتقوى وتحريم التعاون على الإثم والعدوان
candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Establishes social cooperation as moral category requiring active discernment. Four-term taxonomy (birr taqwa ithm udwan) covers personal piety and social harm dimensions. Collective responsibility framework distinguishing permissible from impermissible solidarity. Applicable to political alliances economic partnerships civil society engagement.

candidates.label: Regulated interfaith permeability: mutual food permissibility with People of Book and marriage to their chaste women under specified conditions
candidates.definition: In 5:5: This day good things made lawful; food of those given Scripture lawful for you and your food lawful for them; chaste women from believers and chaste women from those given Scripture before you when given due compensation desiring chastity not fornication or secret lovers.

evidence.excerpt: ٱلۡيَوۡمَ أُحِلَّ لَكُمُ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتُۖ وَطَعَامُ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ حِلّٞ لَّكُمۡ وَطَعَامُكُمۡ حِلّٞ لَّهُمۡۖ وَٱلۡمُحۡصَنَٰتُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ وَٱلۡمُحۡصَنَٰتُ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ مِن قَبۡلِكُمۡ إِذَآ ءَاتَيۡتُمُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ مُحۡصِنِينَ غَيۡرَ مُسَٰفِحِينَ وَلَا مُتَّخِذِيٓ أَخۡدَانٖۗ وَمَن يَكۡفُرۡ بِٱلۡإِيمَٰنِ فَقَدۡ حَبِطَ عَمَلُهُۥ وَهُوَ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ مِنَ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ
evidence.rationale: WataAAamu allatheena ootoo alkitaba hillun lakum wataAAamukum hillun lahum: reciprocal food permissibility unique to People of Book. Waalmuhsanatu mina allatheena ootoo alkitaba: marriage permission conditioned on ihsan (chastity). Muhsineena ghayra musafiheena wala muttakhithee akhdanin: three behavioral conditions ensuring legitimate union.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Primary textual anchor for interfaith marriage ruling
Extends halal framework to include People of Book food

candidates.urduLabel: النفاذية المنظمة بين الأديان: تبادل حل الطعام مع أهل الكتاب ونكاح محصناتهم بشروط
candidates.notes: Overlap with interfaith-marriage and halal-food. Reciprocal food ruling creates shared commensality space. Marriage permission asymmetric (Muslim men to PoB women only). Chastity triple-condition prevents exploitation. Habita amaluhu warning ties interfaith permissibility to continued faith commitment.

candidates.label: Tayammum concession: dry ablution with clean earth when water unavailable expressing divine legislative intent of ease not hardship
candidates.definition: In 5:6: If ill or traveling or from privy or contacted women and no water found then seek clean earth and wipe faces and hands. Allah does not intend difficulty but intends purification and completion of favor for gratitude.

evidence.excerpt: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا قُمۡتُمۡ إِلَى ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ فَٱغۡسِلُواْ وُجُوهَكُمۡ وَأَيۡدِيَكُمۡ إِلَى ٱلۡمَرَافِقِ وَٱمۡسَحُواْ بِرُءُوسِكُمۡ وَأَرۡجُلَكُمۡ إِلَى ٱلۡكَعۡبَيۡنِۚ وَإِن كُنتُمۡ جُنُبٗا فَٱطَّهَّرُواْۚ وَإِن كُنتُم مَّرۡضَىٰٓ أَوۡ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٍ أَوۡ جَآءَ أَحَدٞ مِّنكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡغَآئِطِ أَوۡ لَٰمَسۡتُمُ ٱلنِّسَآءَ فَلَمۡ تَجِدُواْ مَآءٗ فَتَيَمَّمُواْ صَعِيدٗا طَيِّبٗا فَٱمۡسَحُواْ بِوُجُوهِكُمۡ وَأَيۡدِيكُم مِّنۡهُۚ مَا يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ لِيَجۡعَلَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّنۡ حَرَجٖ وَلَٰكِن يُرِيدُ لِيُطَهِّرَكُمۡ وَلِيُتِمَّ نِعۡمَتَهُۥ عَلَيۡكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Fatayammamoo saAAeedan tayyiban faimsahoo biwujoohikum waaydeekum minhu: tayammum procedure specified. Ma yureedu Allahu liyajAAala AAalaykum min harajin walakin yureedu liyutahhirakum: explicit divine rationale negating hardship affirming purification. Waliyutimma niAAmatahu AAalaykum laAAallakum tashkuroona: teleological chain from concession to gratitude.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Tayammum as alternative to wudu when conditions prevent water use

candidates.urduLabel: رخصة التيمم: الطهارة بالتراب عند عدم الماء تعبيراً عن قصد الله للتيسير لا التعسير
candidates.notes: Overlap with tayammum and wudu-procedure. Only Quranic verse combining wudu and tayammum legislation. Haraj (difficulty/hardship) negated as divine intent establishes ease principle. Purification purpose maintained through alternative means. Gratitude as ultimate legislative goal links ritual to spiritual disposition.

candidates.label: Justice overriding enmity: hatred of any people must never prevent just conduct; justice itself is nearer to taqwa
candidates.definition: In 5:8: O believers be persistently standing firm for Allah witnesses in justice; do not let hatred of a people prevent justice. Be just; that is nearer to taqwa. Fear Allah; Allah is Acquainted with what you do.

evidence.excerpt: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ كُونُواْ قَوَّـٰمِينَ لِلَّهِ شُهَدَآءَ بِٱلۡقِسۡطِۖ وَلَا يَجۡرِمَنَّكُمۡ شَنَـَٔانُ قَوۡمٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَلَّا تَعۡدِلُواْۚ ٱعۡدِلُواْ هُوَ أَقۡرَبُ لِلتَّقۡوَىٰۖ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَبِيرُۢ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Wala yajrimannakum shanaanu qawmin AAala alla taAAdiloo: explicit prohibition against enmity-driven injustice. IAAdiloo huwa aqrabu lilttaqwa: justice positioned as proximate to God-consciousness. Koonoo qawwameena lillahi shuhadaa bialqisti: persistent institutional stance required. Khabeerun bima taAAmaloona: divine surveillance ensures accountability.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Key textual anchor for impartial justice obligation

candidates.urduLabel: العدالة فوق العداوة: بغض أي قوم لا يمنع من العدل والعدل أقرب للتقوى
candidates.notes: Overlap with justice-oppression. Parallels 4:135 but adds aqrabu lilttaqwa framing linking justice directly to spiritual proximity. Shanaan (hatred/enmity) identified as systemic threat to judicial integrity. Qawwameena implies structural persistence not situational fairness. Universal application regardless of communal relations.

candidates.label: Covenant breach pattern: parallel violation histories of Israelite and Christian communities producing hardened hearts word-distortion and inter-communal enmity
candidates.definition: In 5:12-14: Allah took covenant from Children of Israel appointing twelve leaders with conditions; whoever disbelieved after that strayed. For breaking covenant We cursed them made hearts hard they distort words forgot portion. From Christians We took covenant they forgot portion so We caused enmity and hatred between them until Resurrection.

evidence.excerpt: ۞وَلَقَدۡ أَخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِيثَٰقَ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ وَبَعَثۡنَا مِنۡهُمُ ٱثۡنَيۡ عَشَرَ نَقِيبٗاۖ وَقَالَ ٱللَّهُ إِنِّي مَعَكُمۡۖ لَئِنۡ أَقَمۡتُمُ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَيۡتُمُ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَءَامَنتُم بِرُسُلِي وَعَزَّرۡتُمُوهُمۡ وَأَقۡرَضۡتُمُ ٱللَّهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنٗا لَّأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنكُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمۡ وَلَأُدۡخِلَنَّكُمۡ جَنَّـٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۚ فَمَن كَفَرَ بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ مِنكُمۡ فَقَدۡ ضَلَّ سَوَآءَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
evidence.rationale: Walaqad akhatha Allahu meethaqa banee israeela: covenant establishment. Famankafara baAAda thalika minkum faqad dalla sawaa alssabeeli: post-covenant disbelief as deviation.

evidence.excerpt: فَبِمَا نَقۡضِهِم مِّيثَٰقَهُمۡ لَعَنَّـٰهُمۡ وَجَعَلۡنَا قُلُوبَهُمۡ قَٰسِيَةٗۖ يُحَرِّفُونَ ٱلۡكَلِمَ عَن مَّوَاضِعِهِۦ وَنَسُواْ حَظّٗا مِّمَّا ذُكِّرُواْ بِهِۦۚ وَلَا تَزَالُ تَطَّلِعُ عَلَىٰ خَآئِنَةٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗا مِّنۡهُمۡۖ فَٱعۡفُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَٱصۡفَحۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
evidence.rationale: Fabima naqdihim meethaqahum laAAannahum wajaAAalna quloobahum qasiyatan: causal chain breach-curse-hardening. Yuharrifoona alkalima AAan mawadiAAihi: textual distortion as symptom.

evidence.excerpt: وَمِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا نَصَٰرَىٰٓ أَخَذۡنَا مِيثَٰقَهُمۡ فَنَسُواْ حَظّٗا مِّمَّا ذُكِّرُواْ بِهِۦ فَأَغۡرَيۡنَا بَيۡنَهُمُ ٱلۡعَدَاوَةَ وَٱلۡبَغۡضَآءَ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۚ وَسَوۡفَ يُنَبِّئُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَصۡنَعُونَ
evidence.rationale: Wamina allatheena qaloo inna nasara akhathna meethaqahum fanasoo haththan: parallel Christian breach. Faaghrayna baynahumu alAAadawata waalbaghdaa: internal enmity as consequence.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Illustrates covenant breach consequences rather than covenant theology itself
Primary textual exposition of covenant breach pattern

candidates.urduLabel: نمط نقض العهد: تاريخ موازٍ لانتهاك بني إسرائيل والنصارى أدى إلى قسوة القلوب وتحريف الكلم والعداوة
candidates.notes: Overlap with covenants-ahd and covenant-breach. Dual-community structure shows breach as recurrent pattern not isolated failure. Hardened hearts and word-distortion presented as progressive spiritual degradation. Internal enmity among Christians contrasts with Muslim unity ideal. Pardon recommendation (5:13) tempers critique with mercy posture.

candidates.label: Refutation of Christian divinization: explicit rejection of Allah-is-Messiah and third-of-three claims with logical arguments from divine sovereignty and Messiah's own testimony
candidates.definition: In 5:17: They have disbelieved who say Allah is Messiah son of Maryam. Say who could prevent Allah if He intended to destroy Messiah his mother and everyone on earth? To Allah belongs dominion of heavens earth and between them He creates what He wills Allah over all things Competent.

evidence.excerpt: لَّقَدۡ كَفَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡمَسِيحُ ٱبۡنُ مَرۡيَمَۚ قُلۡ فَمَن يَمۡلِكُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيۡـًٔا إِنۡ أَرَادَ أَن يُهۡلِكَ ٱلۡمَسِيحَ ٱبۡنَ مَرۡيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥ وَمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعٗاۗ وَلِلَّهِ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاۚ يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ
evidence.rationale: Laqad kafara allatheena qaloo inna Allaha huwa almaseehu ibnu maryama: direct identification of claim as kufr. Qul faman yamliku mina Allahi shayan: rhetorical challenge from divine omnipotence. Walillahi mulku alssamawati waalardi: ontological argument from ownership. Yakhluqu ma yashao waAllahu AAala kulli shayin qadeerun: creative sovereignty excludes partnership.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Focuses on theological refutation rather than narrative biography
Specific application addressing Christian christological claims

candidates.urduLabel: دحض تأليه المسيح: رفض صريح لدعوى أن الله هو المسيح وأقنوم الثالث بأدلة السيادة الإلهية وشهادة المسيح نفسه
candidates.notes: Overlap with isa-story and shirk-prohibition. Arguments proceed from divine attributes not historical evidence. Rhetorical question format invites listener to recognize logical impossibility. Dominion-creation-competence triad establishes comprehensive divine exclusivity. Addresses both incarnation (Allah is Messiah) and trinity (third of three) formulations.

candidates.label: Holy Land refusal: Israelite defiance of divine command to enter sacred territory resulting in forty-year wandering as collective consequence of communal disobedience
candidates.definition: In 5:21-26: Musa commanded people enter Holy Land Allah assigned; they refused citing tyrannical inhabitants; two faithful men urged entry with tawakkul; people defiantly said go you and your Lord fight we sit here; Musa appealed to Allah; Allah decreed forty years wandering in land; do not grieve over defiantly disobedient people.

evidence.excerpt: يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱدۡخُلُواْ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ ٱلۡمُقَدَّسَةَ ٱلَّتِي كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡ وَلَا تَرۡتَدُّواْ عَلَىٰٓ أَدۡبَارِكُمۡ فَتَنقَلِبُواْ خَٰسِرِينَ
evidence.rationale: Ya qawmi odkhuloo alarda almuqaddasata allatee kataba Allahu lakum: divine assignment framed as written decree. Wala tartaddoo AAala adbarikum: warning against retreat.

evidence.excerpt: قَالُواْ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَن نَّدۡخُلَهَآ أَبَدٗا مَّا دَامُواْ فِيهَا فَٱذۡهَبۡ أَنتَ وَرَبُّكَ فَقَٰتِلَآ إِنَّا هَٰهُنَا قَٰعِدُونَ
evidence.rationale: Faithhab anta warabbuka faqatila inna hahuna qaAAidoona: peak defiance separating Musa from community. Hahuna qaAAidoona: deliberate immobility as resistance.

evidence.excerpt: قَالَ فَإِنَّهَا مُحَرَّمَةٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡۛ أَرۡبَعِينَ سَنَةٗۛ يَتِيهُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ فَلَا تَأۡسَ عَلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡفَٰسِقِينَ
evidence.rationale: Fainnaha muharramatun AAalayhim arbaAAeena sanatan yateehoona fee alardi: proportional punishment matching refusal duration. Fala tasa AAala alqawmi alfasiqeena: prophetic consolation.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Specific episode within broader Musa narrative

candidates.urduLabel: رفض الأرض المقدسة: عصيان بني إسرائيل لأمر دخول الأرض المقدسة وعقابهم بالتيه أربعين سنة
candidates.notes: Overlap with musa-story. Illustrates covenant-consequence mechanism through concrete historical case. Communal punishment despite individual faithful minority (two men). Forty-year duration matches generational timeframe suggesting complete turnover. Fasiqeen characterization links disobedience to moral category. Consolation directive protects prophet from communal grief burden.

candidates.label: Sanctity of life universal formula: unjust killing of one soul equals killing all mankind; saving one equals saving all mankind
candidates.definition: In 5:32: Because of that We decreed upon Children of Israel that whoever kills a soul not for soul or corruption in land it is as if he killed mankind entirely and whoever saves one it is as if he saved mankind entirely. Our messengers came with clear proofs then many transgressed after that in land.

evidence.excerpt: مِنۡ أَجۡلِ ذَٰلِكَ كَتَبۡنَا عَلَىٰ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ أَنَّهُۥ مَن قَتَلَ نَفۡسَۢا بِغَيۡرِ نَفۡسٍ أَوۡ فَسَادٖ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَكَأَنَّمَا قَتَلَ ٱلنَّاسَ جَمِيعٗا وَمَنۡ أَحۡيَاهَا فَكَأَنَّمَآ أَحۡيَا ٱلنَّاسَ جَمِيعٗاۚ وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَتۡهُمۡ رُسُلُنَا بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ ثُمَّ إِنَّ كَثِيرٗا مِّنۡهُم بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ لَمُسۡرِفُونَ
evidence.rationale: Man qatala nafsan bighayri nafsin aw fasadin fee alardi fakaannama qatala alnnasa jameeAAan: equivalence formula with two exceptions (just retribution anti-corruption). Waman ahyaha fakaannama ahya alnnasa jameeAAan: symmetric positive formulation. Katabna AAala banee israeela: originally decreed for Israel extended universally by Quranic citation. Thumma inna katheeran minhum baAAda thalika fee alardi lamusrifoona: acknowledgment that principle often violated despite clarity.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Primary Quranic articulation of life sanctity principle

candidates.urduLabel: قدسية الحياة الشاملة: قتل نفس واحدة بغير حق كقتل الناس جميعاً وإحياؤها كإحيائهم جميعاً
candidates.notes: Overlap with right-to-life. Universal quantification (jameeAAan) removes particularistic limitation. Dual exception clause (nafs fasad) acknowledges legitimate state violence. Positive formulation (saving equals saving all) balances prohibition with affirmative duty. Citation from Israelite decree suggests pre-Quranic origin now reaffirmed. Musrifoon diagnosis explains gap between principle and practice.

candidates.label: Hirabah penal framework: graduated punishments for armed rebellion against Allah and Messenger causing societal corruption with repentance exception before capture
candidates.definition: In 5:33-34: Penalty for those waging war against Allah and Messenger striving in land for corruption: killed or crucified or hands and feet cut off from opposite sides or exiled from land; disgrace in world great punishment hereafter. Except those who repent before you overcome them; know Allah Forgiving Merciful.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّمَا جَزَـٰٓؤُاْ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحَارِبُونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَيَسۡعَوۡنَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَسَادًا أَن يُقَتَّلُوٓاْ أَوۡ يُصَلَّبُوٓاْ أَوۡ تُقَطَّعَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَأَرۡجُلُهُم مِّنۡ خِلَٰفٍ أَوۡ يُنفَوۡاْ مِنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ ذَٰلِكَ لَهُمۡ خِزۡيٞ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَلَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
evidence.rationale: Innama jazao allatheena yuhariboona Allaha warasoolahu wayasAAawna fee alardi fasadan: crime defined as war against divine order plus active corruption. An yuqattaloo aw yusallaboo aw tuqattaAAa aydeehim waarjuluhum min khilafin aw yunfaw mina alardi: four graduated penalties. Thalika lahum khizyun fee alddunya: worldly disgrace component.

evidence.excerpt: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ تَابُواْ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن تَقۡدِرُواْ عَلَيۡهِمۡۖ فَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
evidence.rationale: Illa allatheena taboo min qabli an taqdiroo AAalayhim: temporal condition for repentance exception. FaiAAlamoo anna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun: divine mercy affirmed even for gravest offenders.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Hirabah as specific hudud category distinct from theft or zina

candidates.urduLabel: إطار عقوبة الحرابة: عقوبات متدرجة للمحاربين المفسدين مع استثناء التوبة قبل القبض
candidates.notes: Overlap with hudud-punishments. Crime combines theological (war against Allah) and social (corruption) dimensions. Four penalties suggest proportionality based on severity. Min khilaf (opposite sides) specifies cross-amputation method. Exile as least severe option preserves life. Repentance-before-capture clause maintains reform possibility. Khizy (disgrace) adds reputational dimension beyond physical penalty.
